monument_type_scaffold.canonical_h1_instruction: Emit H1 (`# ...`) at primary monthly/seasonal divisions of the Anthologion/Menaion: `# PREFACE`, `# MONTH OF SEPTEMBER`..`# MONTH OF AUGUST`, `# GENERAL MENAION (COMMON SERVICES TO THE SAINTS)`, and `# CONCLUDING APPENDICES AND COLOPHON`.
prompt_guardrails: Emit `# MONTH OF <NAME>` only at primary monthly headpieces; render individual feast days as `##` (when H1 & H2 is enabled) or inline italics.
Flush leaves to disk every 2-3 physical leaves during long Festal Synaxaria.

engine_codified_decisions.melodic_models_podobny: 3-Layer Canonical Standard enforced by hymnographic_gold_normalizer.py: *Tone N, Podoben: "<Canonical English Incipit>" (<Slavonic Witness>):* (never transliterated-first or square-bracketed).
engine_codified_decisions.heading_and_rubric_hierarchy: H1 (#) reserved strictly for Part landmarks in publication_spec; H2 (##) allowed only for primary printed day/service headpieces when H1 & H2 is enabled in flash_execution_guardrails; all sub-services, hours, canons, odes, heirmoi, troparia, and rubrics rendered as inline italics (*...*), never ### or ####.
engine_codified_decisions.canon_and_stanza_typography: Structured Liturgical Stanzas: each Heirmos, Troparion, Theotokion, and Sticheron is a distinct paragraph preceded by its inline italic role tag (*Ode N. Heirmos:*, *Troparion:*, *Theotokion:*). Litany/dialogue speakers in bold (**Priest:**, **Deacon:**, **Choir:**).
engine_codified_decisions.recensional_variants_and_homilies: 100% Epigraphic Fidelity (Rule 16): translate the physical print strictly as inked without silent harmonization to Nikonian or standard modern editions; document significant recensional variants in footnotes [^N].
engine_codified_decisions.front_matter_paratext_and_titulature: Baroque heraldic virshi rendered in formal rhythmic unrhymed verse with heraldic notes; Early Modern Ruthenian (prosta mova) prefaces rendered in elevated 17th-century theological prose with marginal citations mapped to [^N]; Imperial, Papal, and Archiepiscopal titulature rendered in full diplomatic translation.
engine_codified_decisions.modular_part_slicing_and_appendices: Follow physical leaf order 100% (Part 0 front matter, Part 1..K primary liturgical divisions/Tones) and isolate distinct rear appendices (Parastas, Hagiography, Typikon/Gospel Pillars) into their own dedicated final Part.
engine_codified_decisions.patristic_synaxarion_diction: Statutory Mandate 13: Render narrative Synaxaria, Patristic Homilies, and Martyrological Passions in elevated classical patristic English prose. Strictly forbid pseudo-archaic AI vocabulary (peradventure, verily, betwixt, twas, methinks, hearken, wherefore, forsooth, haply, albeit) and 3rd-person -eth verbs across both body text and footnotes. Flush translated leaves incrementally every 2-3 leaves.
engine_codified_decisions.diachronic_drift_invariance: Statutory Mandate 11: Translate identical original-language terms, rubrical formulas, and hymnographic phrases identically across multi-century monument series using the canonical shared lexicon so zero artificial English translator drift is introduced, while translating genuine recensional variants strictly as inked.
